description: Hand-authored facts the Penpot file cannot express: which Penpot component maps to which code, icon names, and behaviour notes. Reviewed by a human; validated against the repo and presets.ts by spec-to-tamagui.mjs.

statusLegend.exists: Reuse as-is. File and export must resolve in the repo (validated).
statusLegend.extend: Reuse an existing component and add behaviour/variants (named in `change`).
statusLegend.new: Does not exist. `proposedFile` is a suggestion, final location is decided in the [Feature].
statusLegend.third-party: Rendered by a third-party SDK. The Penpot frame is a placeholder, nothing to build.
statusLegend.slot: Placeholder for an embedded widget (Claim, AI Credits, ...). Mount the existing widget as-is; nothing to build or restyle.

WidgetSlot.notes: The wrapper is a shell: header, bottom bar and drawer around the existing widget packages. Widget content is never redrawn or duplicated here.

BottomAppBar.notes: Fixed bar, fill-width, 5 slots. Slot count (4 pinned + More) is configurable per the Notion spec.

BottomBarItem.notes: Active shows the Indicator layer, loading swaps the glyph for Spinner (sm), disabled is used for the More slot when four or fewer widgets exist.

EcosystemHeader.notes: Owns title, network and wallet. The embedded widget's own header must be hidden (needs a hideHeader switch upstream, see openQuestions).

WidgetDrawer.change: Same frame (32px top radius, $backgroundHover, $borderColor). Add the widget list content and the header title; Drawer already provides scrim via DrawerOverlay.

WidgetListRow.notes: Icon, name, description, optional active marker.

WidgetUnavailable.notes: Shown when the chosen widget does not support the connected network.

WalletChip.notes: Address format in the design (0x1a2…f9c) matches the compact shortAddress form.

WalletModal.notes: Reown AppKit modal, drawn as a placeholder in Penpot.

icons.note: Glyph paths are not machine-readable from Penpot. Names refer to Icon.tsx SVG_PATHS; widget icons in the bottom bar are placeholders until the Notion spec confirms final art. Per-widget icon names are not yet decided.

openQuestions: Single-widget mode (bottom bar hidden) is not drawn.
Superfluid Campaign has no Penpot components yet, so its wrapper frame cannot be generated.
Hiding the embedded widget's own header needs an upstream hideHeader switch in each widget.
